gotchas: THIS IS NOT A DIALECT. It is one row so nobody researches these thirty-odd series twice. Grouping them together asserts NOTHING about a shared register map — it asserts only that no register map source was found for any of them in this sweep. Do not read the shared id as a shared map.

What is missing, uniformly: EPEver publishes exactly three controller/inverter protocol documents that name their scope (A/B-series v2.5, B-series v2.3, Inverter V1.0), plus the UPower spreadsheet. Between them they name LS-B, VS-B, Tracer-A, Tracer-B, iTracer, eTracer, IP, IP-Plus, NP, SHI and UP. Every series listed

The temptation to fold LS-E, VS-AU and LS-EPD into epever-tracer-a because "LS-B is in the doc and these are all LandStar PWM" should be resisted for exactly the reason this catalogue exists. Product-family name is not evidence.

The G3 question cuts across this row and epever-tracer-a both: EPEver has moved its whole controller line to a G3 generation (XTRA-N G3, Tracer AN G3, IT-NC G3, ET-NC G3) whose manuals add a BMS Primary/Secondary mode and an RS485 enable/disable menu that the pre-G3 units did not have.
